verdict.rationale: Jan's README lists both local model download and execution from HuggingFace and cloud integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax and others. Its docs say users can 'switch freely between local and frontier models' and 'plug in your favorite online models' alongside open models in the same app. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring cloud providers (API keys, per-chat model switching UI), independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed local/cloud use.
